releaseNotes: Reworked Android customer display into a dedicated secondary-display activity so the cashier touchscreen remains on the primary display
Hardened printed receipts to remove processor/reference lines and show cashier as first name plus last initial
Improved customer-display persistence and refresh behavior on display reconnects
Added layered login, signup, API, admin, messaging, and database write rate limits
Added optional Turnstile verification and server-side owner/admin role checks
Reduced repeated dashboard polling and hardened request size, origin, and secret-key checks
Removed duplicate patch trees, stale backups, caches, and raw admin login-attempt records
Prevent ZXing barcode modules from loading during SSR so marketing, owner, and admin routes start reliably
Atomic and idempotent POS sale finalization
Immediate offline cash checkout with durable retry states
Protection against losing unsynced records during store reassignment
Encrypted Android device pairing secrets and disabled app-data backup
Persistent offline product image cache and safer product-grid spacing
Support lifecycle, audit logging, and maintenance consistency fixes
Whole-sentence language fallback without corrupting product or brand text
